framework.name: Azure Well-Architected Framework
framework.description: Microsoft's cross-cutting architecture benchmark: 5 pillars, 59 design-review checklist controls.

controls.title: Simplicity & efficiency
controls.description: Keep the design as simple as the business requirements allow; avoid unneeded complexity.

controls.title: Flow identification & criticality
controls.description: Enumerate user/system flows and rank them by business criticality.

controls.title: Failure mode analysis
controls.description: Systematically identify dependencies, failure points, and mitigations (FMEA-style).

controls.title: Reliability targets
controls.description: Set explicit availability/recovery targets (SLO/RTO/RPO) to drive design and health modeling.

controls.title: Redundancy
controls.description: Add redundant components/instances for critical flows to meet reliability targets.

controls.title: Scaling strategy
controls.description: Implement timely, mostly-automatic scaling across app/data/infra tiers.

controls.title: Self-healing
controls.description: Build in self-preservation/self-healing so the workload degrades gracefully and recovers.

controls.title: Resiliency testing / chaos engineering
controls.description: Proactively test failure and load scenarios rather than waiting for real incidents.

controls.title: Disaster recovery plans
controls.description: Maintain a tested, documented DR plan covering the whole system, not just pieces.

controls.title: Health monitoring
controls.description: Continuously track uptime/reliability signals to support detection and post-incident review.

controls.title: Security baseline
controls.description: Define a security baseline aligned to compliance/industry/platform norms and measure against it.

controls.title: Secure SDLC
controls.description: Bake security into every phase of the development lifecycle.

controls.title: Data classification
controls.description: Label data/systems by sensitivity to drive design and prioritization decisions.

controls.title: Segmentation
controls.description: Create intentional boundaries across network, identity, and resource organization.

controls.title: Identity & access management
controls.description: Enforce least-privilege, auditable, modern IAM for all users/components.

controls.title: Network controls
controls.description: Filter and isolate ingress/egress traffic with defense-in-depth.

controls.title: Encryption
controls.description: Encrypt data at rest/in transit using modern, platform-native methods aligned to classification.

controls.title: Hardening
controls.description: Reduce attack surface by tightening configuration on every component.

controls.title: Secrets management
controls.description: Protect, rotate, and audit application secrets.

controls.title: Threat detection
controls.description: Run a holistic, modern threat-monitoring strategy feeding SecOps processes.

controls.title: Security testing
controls.description: Combine testing approaches to validate prevention and detection controls.

controls.title: Incident response
controls.description: Define and rehearse incident response procedures with clear ownership.

controls.title: Financial responsibility culture
controls.description: Train teams and foster spend accountability and automation.

controls.title: Cost model
controls.description: Maintain an estimate of initial/run-rate/ongoing costs with budget buffer.

controls.title: Cost data review
controls.description: Capture daily cost data, trends, forecasts; automate anomaly alerts.

controls.title: Spending guardrails
controls.description: Use policy/limits/gates to prevent overspend, favoring automation.

controls.title: Best rates
controls.description: Regularly review pricing tiers/models/commitments/purchasing plans.

controls.title: Billing alignment
controls.description: Match resource usage patterns to how the service actually bills.

controls.title: Component cost optimization
controls.description: Remove/right-size unneeded or underused features and resources.

controls.title: Environment cost optimization
controls.description: Align spend across prod/non-prod/DR environments to actual need.

controls.title: Flow cost optimization
controls.description: Spend proportional to each flow's business priority.

controls.title: Data cost optimization
controls.description: Tune tiering, retention, replication, and storage format for cost.

controls.title: Code cost optimization
controls.description: Adjust code so it needs fewer/cheaper resources for the same requirements.

controls.title: Scaling cost optimization
controls.description: Choose scale-unit configurations and demand-shaping to control cost.

controls.title: Personnel time optimization
controls.description: Reduce toil (noisy alerts, slow builds, poor debugging) that wastes engineer time.

controls.title: Consolidation
controls.description: Increase density and reuse shared/centralized resources where possible.

controls.title: DevOps culture
controls.description: Define shared practices and a blameless, continuous-improvement culture.

controls.title: Standardize operations
controls.description: Make routine/ad-hoc/emergency operations consistent and predictable.

controls.title: Standardize development
controls.description: Formalize and make transparent the full software delivery lifecycle.

controls.title: Tooling & process standards
controls.description: Standardize tools, source control, patterns, and documentation.

controls.title: Infrastructure as code
controls.description: Provision via IaC, preferring declarative approaches, for consistency.

controls.title: Deployment supply chain
controls.description: Drive change through automated, tested pipelines across environments.

controls.title: Observability / instrumentation
controls.description: Design telemetry/metrics/logging that validates decisions and guides improvement.

controls.title: Incident management process
controls.description: Define roles/procedures for rapid detection, diagnosis, recovery.

controls.title: Quality/testing practices
controls.description: Align testing approach with business objectives and quality bars.

controls.title: Automation
controls.description: Automate repetitive, high-ROI tasks reliably and securely.

controls.title: Safe deployment practices
controls.description: Use small, gated, progressive releases with rollback plans.

controls.title: Performance targets
controls.description: Set numeric, requirement-driven performance targets per flow.

controls.title: Capacity planning
controls.description: Plan capacity ahead of predictable demand changes.

controls.title: Service selection
controls.description: Choose services/tiers that can hit targets and absorb capacity changes.

controls.title: Performance monitoring
controls.description: Measure performance consistently over time against baselines.

controls.title: Scaling & partitioning
controls.description: Design scale units and partitioning for controlled, reliable scaling.

controls.title: Performance testing
controls.description: Regularly test in production-like environments against targets.

controls.title: Code/infra optimization
controls.description: Keep code/infra lean, performant, and platform-offloaded.

controls.title: Data performance optimization
controls.description: Tune stores, partitions, and indexes for actual access patterns.

controls.title: Critical flow prioritization
controls.description: Focus optimization effort on the highest-priority flows first.

controls.title: Operational task impact
controls.description: Minimize how routine ops (backups, scans, rotations) hurt performance.

controls.title: Live incident response
controls.description: Have clear ownership/communication for live performance problems.

controls.title: Continuous optimization
controls.description: Keep monitoring and tuning components that degrade over time.
